name: Terminal
description: A shell in a tab, opened in the vault's folder, to run a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor) on your notes. Runs on this machine, or on your other machines (Machines); closing the tab keeps the shell going. An agent started here is told it runs inside Vaultite, plus each plugin's line for agents: Show what agents in terminals are told has it word for word.

shell.label: Shell
shell.description: the shell new terminals start; those already running keep theirs

cursorBlink.label: Blink the terminal cursor
cursorBlink.description: while the terminal has the keyboard

scrollback.label: Scrollback
scrollback.description: lines of history each new terminal keeps

allowUsers.label: Other tailnet logins
allowUsers.description: others on your tailnet who may open terminals, like someone@example.com

allowRemote.label: Anyone who reaches the app
allowRemote.description: any device that reaches the app may open terminals: only on a network you trust
